description: 24 qwq reasoning tasks with expected outputs

tasks.prompt: A bakery sells muffins for $3 each. It sold 47 muffins in the morning and 38 in the afternoon. Ingredients for the day cost $85. What is the day's profit in dollars?
A train travels at 84 km/h for 3.5 hours, then covers another 126 km. How many kilometers did it travel in total?
A tank holds 1200 liters. It drains at 45 liters per minute for 12 minutes, then 260 liters are added. How many liters are in the tank now?
A jacket costs $240. It is discounted by 15%, and then 10% tax is charged on the discounted price. What is the final price in dollars?
Six workers can build a wall in 10 days. Assuming all workers work at the same rate, how many days would 8 workers need?
What is the next number in the sequence 3, 7, 15, 31, 63?
A rectangle has perimeter 56. Its length is 4 more than its width. What is its area?
Maria already has $270 saved. She saves $45 per week toward a goal of $1035. How many weeks until she reaches her goal?
Three numbers sum to 90. The second is twice the first, and the third is three times the first. What is the third number?
96 students must travel in vans that hold 14 students each. How many vans are needed so every student has a seat?
A cafe has 2.5 kg of coffee beans. Each cup uses 18 grams. How many full cups can be made?
How much simple interest is earned on $2000 at 4.5% per year over 3 years, in dollars?
A book has 320 pages. Tom reads 24 pages per day for 9 days, then finishes the rest at 26 pages per day. How many days did he take in total?
Red and blue marbles are in the ratio 3:5. There are 72 marbles in total. How many are blue?
A car travels 150 miles in 2.5 hours. At the same speed, how many hours does it take to travel 210 miles?
Pencils come in packs of 12 costing $4.80 per pack. At the same per-pencil rate, what do 30 pencils cost in dollars?
A 640-liter tank starts with 120 liters and fills at 8 liters per minute. How many minutes until it is full?
A student's scores on three tests are 78, 85, and 92. What score on the fourth test gives an average of exactly 88 across the four tests?
A fence runs along a 96-meter side, with a post every 4 meters including posts at both ends. How many posts are there?
Three liters of a 20% salt solution are mixed with two liters of a 45% salt solution. What is the salt percentage of the mixture?
A father is three times as old as his son. Their ages sum to 52. How old is the father?
A shop buys 250 items at $6 each and sells them at $9.50 each. What is the total profit in dollars?
347 candies are packed into bags of 12. After filling as many bags as possible, how many candies remain?
A town of 12500 people grows by 4% each year. What is the population after 2 years?
